note: Etowah County publishes no zoning layer (county GIS services at kcsgis.com have parcels, city limits, no zoning). The City of Gadsden's zoning districts service (coggis.cityofgadsden.com Planning/ZoningDynamic MapServer) returns 'Token Required' to every request, so it is not publicly queryable. Rainbow City, Attalla and Glencoe publish only PDF/image maps or ordinances in the search results.
